modeDesc.plain: Official jargon turned into normal language: what do they want from you, by when, and what happens if you do nothing?
modeDesc.grammar: Finds real spelling and grammar mistakes, following the German Duden standard.
modeDesc.formulation: Better word choice and sentence flow, without changing the meaning.
modeDesc.arbeitszeugnis: Decodes the hidden phrases in a German employment reference and gives it a grade.
modeDesc.contract: Checks every clause and uses a traffic light to show what puts you at a disadvantage.
modeDesc.summary: A factual summary with the key facts and what needs doing.
modeDesc.freeform: Ask your own question about the document.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoUpdate: Automatically check for updates on start
settings.autoUpdateHint: Only queries the version number from GitHub - no documents or usage data are transmitted. When off, DoZii stays fully offline (except Ollama).
settings.languageHint: Interface language. Analysis output is generated in this language too (except the German reference decoder, which stays German).
settings.notInstalledHintSuffix: and install it. Then you can start it directly here.
settings.cpuHint: Runs without a dedicated graphics card - only RAM is needed.
settings.gpuHint: Needs a GPU with enough VRAM for best speed. Otherwise falls back to slower CPU.
settings.budgetTitle: Runs on weak hardware and still handles reference decoding
settings.budgetExplain: Models with the BUDGET-FRIENDLY badge run on weak hardware too (from 8 GB RAM, no GPU needed) and still manage reference decoding - just at ~30-90 seconds per analysis instead of under 10s.
settings.logsDesc: All app events, errors and stack traces are stored locally in daily-rotated log files. Useful for troubleshooting and development.

strengths.gemma3:1b: Ultra-light - runs on any old laptop

settings.autoAnalyzeHint: DoZii detects the document type and starts the matching mode automatically.
settings.redactOnExportHint: IBAN, case number, phone and email are blacked out in the export.
settings.autoContextWindowHint: Uses the model's full context window so long documents don't get cut off. Needs more memory.
settings.ollamaUrlHint: Only change this if Ollama runs on a different port or machine.
settings.ollamaUrlInvalid: That is not a valid address (expected: http://host:port).
settings.ocrLanguagesHint: Applies to photos and scanned PDFs. German and English are included.
settings.ocrQualityHint: "Best" takes longer, but reads blurry phone photos much better.

az.notGenuineDesc: This text does not appear to be a German employment reference. The reference decoder only works with genuine references (with a duties description, performance assessment and closing formula).
az.dualDesc: Content = what the reference SAYS about you (performance assessment, hidden codes, red flags). Structure = how skillfully/professionally it is WRITTEN (completeness, HR conformity, language quality). The two are independent.

kindDesc.widerspruch: Against decisions from public offices and authorities. Usually a one-month deadline.
kindDesc.einspruch: Against fine notices (2 weeks) or tax assessments (1 month).
kindDesc.zeugnis-nachbesserung: Asks your employer to change individual wordings.
kindDesc.mahnung-antwort: Dispute the claim, offer to pay in installments or prove you already paid.
kindDesc.kuendigung: Terminate a contract at the earliest possible date.
kindDesc.fristverlaengerung: Ask for more time if you cannot make the deadline.
kindDesc.allgemein: A factual reply to a letter.
